hypothesis: Adding one T1 prefetch at byte512 of each existing changed threat/pawn-pair row hint on the automatic AVX-512 path may start its second512-byte tile sooner. The profile identifies indexed updates as expensive, but establishes no cache-stall cause; this is a speculative engineering policy, not novelty or strength.

implementation.policy: Keep the existing base-row T1 prefetch in features::prefetch_row_at. Only with midpoint-prefetch compiled and kernels::level()==LEVEL_AVX512, issue exactly one additional same-hint prefetch at base.wrapping_add(index*1024).wrapping_add(512), under the existing nonnull guard. Preserve all indices including existing sentinel handling, weight data, arithmetic, accumulator loops and search. No alternative hints/distances, added piece-square prefetch or fusion.
implementation.build: Rust1.99.1 release locked; existing x86-64-v3 flags; no PGO/instrumentation/debug overrides; separate target directory; retain production6b unchanged. Freeze baseline before implementation and candidate before queries.

timing.warm: Exactly one depth8 startpos search per engine/mode, baseline then candidate, excluded from totals. Each role has one persistent process per mode, Threads1 Hash64, every measured root new game with full legal history.
timing.ordering: For batch b traverse root indices0..15 if b even,15..0 if b odd. For root ordinal j within that traversal, run baseline then candidate if (b+j)%2==0, otherwise candidate then baseline. Thus every batch has8AB and8BA; each root has equal first/second slots across even replication counts. Order is per root, not per whole batch.
timing.metric: Median candidate/baseline total wall elapsed per16root batch, protocol/reset included; whole-batch bootstrap95%, matched roots. Desktop not affinity-isolated; no Elo from timing.

gates.before_timing: Feature and default debug/release native tests; source names/format; canonical1559611 and all51normalized traces all3modes; all80freshdepth9roots eachmode; unchanged three20k-node tactics suites; independent legality/perft/edges, actualHTTP/SSEplay, proof verification and SMPready/stop/undo; exact source/binary preservation. Existing arithmetic tests suffice: only non-dereferencing hints change, no new arithmetic.
gates.conditional_matches: Only after all correctness/exactness/timing gates pass, complete32pairs30ms then32pairs100ms on disjoint frozen ranges, color swapped,1thread64MiB,max400plies,no adjudication. Persist journals/PGNs; complete/audit all128games once started even if firstcontrol fails. No unresolved/forfeits, reject engineering regression if whole-opening-family95% upper score bound below50%;20000bootstrapseed20261020018. Not an Elo-gain claim.
gates.adoption: All gates and Windows/Linux CI must pass before default adoption. No adoption while checks pending. A timing failure prospectively skips all64pairs and restores original live engine/Cargo/workflow source after archiving candidate.
gates.strength: No strength or novelty claim from speed. Separate predeclared current-reference multi-control confirmation and exact-binary Elo calibration remain required.

failure_policy: One policy and attempt only; no hint/distance variants, retuning, replacement timing, extra games or threshold changes. Stop candidate on any unexpected exactness/timeout/error; preserve partial evidence. No repairs after timing starts. Correctness-only bug repair before timing must preserve first attempt and be separately recorded, maximum2. Existing failed experiments remain closed.
